node.text:
The Best Day of my life ❤️ 12.07.25 💍 
Mr & Mrs Daniels! 🥳

Well… what a day! 🤩

I made my debut on the @premierleague show IN STUDIO!!!!! 😮 

A day to be grateful. Thank you all for the support and giving me these opportunities! ♥️

Such cool experience!
Will be on SKY + TNT Sports tonight.
Link ➡️ https://www.premierleague.com/video/single/4115764

Something special arrived in the post today 😊❤️

It just sets to remind me how grateful I continue to be to you all for helping me achieve this.
It is actually insane that it has happened 🤩 

The support over the past 4 years has just been beyond my wildest dreams and I love every single moment of it, even the red arrows don’t feel so bad.

I wish I could say thank you to you all individually for everything and all the clicks, views, subscribers and ongoing support but this will have to do 👍❤️

When I started this channel I did it because it was to pass some time and I loved FPL, I couldn’t imagine how far it would have come, how much I enjoy every single Gameweek and it would become such a massive part of my life.

Thank you all so much, really is such a dream come true I can’t say how appreciative I am enough times.

Thank you thank you thank you for joining me and helping me on this journey 💙
